newsitem.title: USA: Columbia Gas System Inc Q4 shr profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Columbia Gas System Inc Q4 shr profit vs loss.

text.p: First Call mean estimate for Q4 was $1.28 per share
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE - 1996 results includes an after-tax charge of $35.7 million related to restructuring costs, primarily for severance costs. The 1996 results also include a $5.6 million benefit to reflect a favorable adjustment to the sale of the southwestern natural gas and oil production subsidiary, Columbia Development Corp, which was sold at the end of 1995.

1995 results include a $518.2 million after-tax charge related to bankruptcy issues; a $71.6 million benefit for the readoption of an accounting standard dealing with the treatment of regulatory assets for its transmission companies; a $54.8 million after-tax loss on the sale of its southwestern natural gas and oil production subsidiary.
